title: Plays dumb on AI/ML: the neuron choice matters
caption: With the default choice (8 neurons) the edit, like the standard LoRA, plays dumb on AI/ML but also on near topics and on unrelated chat. 2 neurons chosen at the start of the reply, where they are quiet on near-miss topics, keep the AI/ML behaviour and almost remove the leaks (no negative examples in training; 3 seeds). Each bar: 60 to 258 replies (prompts × seeds; exact n per bar in the JSON file).
axis: share of replies, 0-100%; thin line = 95% Wilson interval
